text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Fest—a huge event
wherein
Tracen Academy opens its doors
to fans of all
ages.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What's more, they'll be treated to a sport
competition between the
academy's Umamusume
that outsiders
don't usually get to witness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be a ball game competition,
huh? I'm
in! Say, Trainer? Do you know
what the biggest
ball sport out there is?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Golf! I mean, soccer's fine and all,
but
golf's the way to go! And with that
said...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be the star today! I'm gonna
take
charge like nobody's business!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The golfing competition is taking place
on the turf track, which has been
temporarily
transformed into a golf
course.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ I've never played golf before,
but I bet I
look more like a golfer than
anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
For my second shot... Maybe I'll use the
6 iron?
Never mind, the 1 wood's the
way to go.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
you're using a 1? But this isn't your
tee
shot.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'd feel like I'd lost to myself if I used
anything
else other than number one,
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Here I go! Line up the shot just right...
and...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ei, ei, muuun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! They're already at it! I'd better
get
swinging too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the competition continues, Mejiro
Palmer does well in the match play
competition and makes it
to the final
hole with a chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's see, looks like my opponent'll be...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Let us have fun, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon, hmm? A front runner
just like
me, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a race, Mejiro Palmer explodes to the
front when her gut says to go, but
Mihono Bourbon calculates every detail
down to the second for her
breakaways.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a veritable clash between emotion
and logic
on the golf course. Which will
emerge victorious?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Measurements complete. Wind
determined to be
blowing north by
northwest at 3.8 meters per
second.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A slice should land the ball within 0.52
meters
from the bunker.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Changing directives from standby to
swing
preparation. Three, two, one! Hup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wooow... Who'd've thunk there was an

Umamusume who could hit that kinda
shot?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
She might actually give me a run for my
money!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(My turn... The course is clear,
and I'm in
the
zone. All I need now are some
victory vibes!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I can't disappoint everyone who's
rooting for
me!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? I thought there'd more eyes be on
me, but I hardly sense anyone watching
the match. Maybe
it's just a low turnout
from my fans...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I guess Umamusume golf isn't that big
of a hit.
Oh well!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's get liiit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I chunked it! Nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Oooooh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer failed to get a good read
on the
wind. As a result...

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: The winner is Mihono Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, you got me good. Congrats,
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing. Do you run that
precisely in
your races too?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. However, I must confess
something.
During today's golf match...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I copied your form.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wha? Huh? You did?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Every shot you made was
well
deliberated and highly rational. In
fact...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I analyzed your races a little as well.
The guts you
display on the final stretch of
your races are
particularly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have a request. Please continue to
exemplify
your flawless running from
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I didn't know you even did
research on
other racers' running styles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No wonder I lost to you today. I've
learned a lot
from you. Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We should have a rematch one day! But
just so
you know, I'm not gonna lose to
you, either on
the track or the green!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged. I await the day with
eager
anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she lost, Mejiro Palmer learns
some valuable lessons from competing
against a front
runner with a different
running style.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We've got your back! Just focus on your
shot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look around and notice the crowd of
people
rooting for Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by an army of fans with all
their
fingers crossed for luck, Mejiro
Palmer brings her
club back, and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Let's get liiit!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hits the perfect shot! The ball
travels in a beautiful arc and disappears
from sight as if
swallowed by the sky
itself. As a result...

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: The winner is Mejiro Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I did it, Trainer! I dunno why, but I felt
so
confident and secure, like I had a
bunch of
people backing me up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, when'd the crowd on my side
get this
big?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A group of fans all wearing the same
button
badge on their chests gather
around us.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Mejiro Palmer! We're
your own
personal fan club!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we're Palmie's Army! Everyone
here loves
how you run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Palmie's Army! I can't believe I've
reached the
point where people are
forming clubs for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm so grateful to my fans! Even better...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
They're not "Mejiro" fans—they're here
for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems people have been inspired by
Mejiro Palmer's persistence as she chases
after true freedom. Her hard work has
resulted in a devoted following, and a
big one at that.
choice_data_list: Yeah, they're your very own cheer ...
Yeah, they're your very own cheer ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everybody! Golf is one thing,
but to hype
all of you up even more on
the track...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm shooting for a hole-in-one at the
spring Tenno
Sho! Waheeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the strong bond that has formed
between Mejiro Palmer and her
fans as the latter
cheer and applaud for
her with great enthusiasm.
